items.name: Greataxe
items.description: This large battle axe is too heavy to wield with only one hand. Many greataxes incorporate two blades, and they are often "bearded," having a hook at the bottom to increase the strength of their chopping power.

items.name: Breastplate
items.description: Though referred to as a breastplate, this type of armor consists of several pieces of plate or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Half Plate] armor that protect the torso, chest, neck, and sometimes the hips and lower legs. It strategically grants some of the protection of plate while allowing greater flexibility and speed.

defensiveAbilities.name: Reactive Strike
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Chill Breath
offensiveAbilities.description:
The frost giant breathes out a 15ft Cone of freezing moisture that quickly condenses into ice, dealing 4d6 Cold Damage damage. Each creature in the cone must attempt a Basic DC 28 Reflex Saving Throw save. A creature that fails its save is also Immobilized and takes 2d6 Cold Damage damage at the end of each of its turns until it gets free (Escape dc=28).

The giant can't use Chill Breath again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ice Stride
offensiveAbilities.description: A frost giant isn't impeded by difficult terrain caused by snow or ice, nor do they need to attempt Acrobatics checks to keep from falling on slippery ice.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wide Swing
offensiveAbilities.description: The frost giant makes a single greataxe Strike and compares the attack roll result to the ACs of up to two foes within their reach. This counts as two attacks for the frost giant's multiple attack penalty.
